description: Capacity, growth forecast, inode headroom and Longhorn replica health for every persistent volume claim in the cluster.

panels.title: Volumes
panels.description: PVCs currently reporting filesystem stats. A PVC without a running pod does not report and is not counted here.

panels.title: Provisioned
panels.description: Sum of the filesystem capacity of the selected volumes.

panels.title: Usage by namespace
panels.description: Used bytes over provisioned bytes, aggregated per namespace.

panels.title: Ten fullest volumes
panels.description: Fill ratio of the ten fullest claims. Derived from available bytes, so filesystem-reserved blocks count as used.

panels.title: Persistent volume claims
panels.description: One row per PVC that currently reports filesystem stats. Click a column header to sort.

panels.title: Free space
panels.description: Absolute headroom per volume. A steady downward slope here is what the fill-forecast alerts extrapolate.

panels.title: Growth per day
panels.description: Bytes a volume gains per day, extrapolated from the six hour trend. Negative means the volume is shrinking.

panels.title: Fill forecast
panels.description: Time until each volume runs out of space at the current growth rate. The six hour column drives LonghornVolumeFillingUpIn24h, the one hour column drives LonghornVolumeFillingUpIn4h. Values are capped at ten years, so idle volumes park at the top of the range.

panels.title: Inode usage
panels.description: A volume with free bytes but no free inodes still fails writes with ENOSPC. Typical for caches holding many small files.

panels.title: Healthy
panels.description: Requires the longhorn-backend scrape. If every panel in this row is empty, check the LonghornManagerMetricsUnavailable alert.

panels.title: Read-only
panels.description: Longhorn only publishes this series while a filesystem is mounted read-only.

panels.title: Rebuilding
panels.description: Replicas currently being rebuilt. A degraded volume with a rebuild in progress is recovering on its own.

panels.title: Managers scraped
panels.description: Zero means every Longhorn panel and alert on this dashboard is blind.

panels.title: Volume robustness and state
panels.description: Longhorn's own view of each volume. Actual size is the sum of the space the replicas occupy on their nodes, so it grows with the replica count and with snapshot history - it is not the same number as the filesystem usage above.

panels.title: Longhorn node storage
panels.description: Used is what the replicas actually occupy, scheduled is what Longhorn has promised to them. Once scheduled reaches the over-provisioning limit, no new replica fits on the node and degraded volumes stay degraded.

panels.title: Latency
panels.description: Longhorn reports latency in nanoseconds; divided by 1e9 here so the axis reads in seconds.

title: Longhorn / Persistent Volumes
